name: Gloom Weed
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Gloom Weed grows in the fields between Deathknell and Brill. Gordo, a lumbering Forsaken abomination, gathers it by mistake while searching for doom weed.

sections.title: A Mistaken Harvest
sections.body: Gloom Weed grows in the fields west of Brill and east of Solliden Farmstead. The plant is harmless, with none of the alchemical strength sought by the Royal Apothecary Society. Gordo, an abomination, wanders the road pulling weeds with his clumsy hands. He misunderstood his master's orders and keeps gathering Gloom Weed instead. Then he asks travelers to carry it to Master Holland in the Brill graveyard, much to the apothecary's annoyance.

faq.q: What is Gloom Weed used for?
faq.answer: Forsaken alchemists have little use for Gloom Weed. Gordo gathers it because he mistakes it for doom weed, the herb his master requested.
Gloom Weed grows in fields across Tirisfal Glades between Brill and Deathknell. It can be found along the road and in meadows east of Solliden Farmstead.

faq.q: Who is Gordo and why is he picking it?
faq.answer: Gordo is an abomination sent by Master Holland to gather reagents. His hands are clumsy and his mind is simple, so he pulls the wrong plants and asks passersby to help him.

faq.q: What did Master Holland actually want?
faq.answer: Master Holland needs doom weed for his experiments in the Brill graveyard. When travelers bring him Gloom Weed, he scoffs at the mistake and sends them to gather the herb he needs.

angles.text: As a trained herbalist, you can sense Gloom Weed with Find Herbs, making it easier to spot in Tirisfal's shadowy undergrowth.
As a Forsaken newly departed from Deathknell, you can learn from fetching Gloom Weed how poorly abominations work and how sharply Undercity alchemists speak.
